name: Halftone

components.title: Button
components.notes: `variant` default/secondary/outline/ghost/link/destructive · `size` sm/default/lg/icon · children are `<Text>`/`<Icon>`
components.caption: Children are Text and Icon, never a bare string. One primary button per screen.

components.title: Toggle
components.notes: pressed two-state button

components.title: Toggle group
components.notes: `type` single/multiple
components.caption: Use type="single" for a segmented control.

components.title: Floating button
components.notes: floats OVER the scroll (a Button flows with it) · Material calls it a FAB · `icon label? variant position` · one per screen
components.caption: Floats over the scroll instead of sitting in it, so the screen’s one most important action stays reachable however far down you are. A Button flows with the content; this does not. Material calls it a FAB. One per screen.

components.title: Icon badge
components.notes: icon button with unread count/dot · always labelled
components.caption: Header icon button with an unread count. The label announces the count for screen readers.

components.title: Swipe to confirm
components.notes: drag past 85% commits · `tone` primary/destructive · reset via `key`
components.caption: For irreversible actions (submit, delete, pay). Reset by changing its key.

components.title: Action grid
components.notes: the row of shortcuts under a screen hero · 3–4 `items`, one row only, last tile is "More"
components.caption: The row of shortcuts under a screen hero. Keep it to one row — the last tile should be "More", not a second row.

components.title: Input
components.notes: always with `Label`
components.caption: Pair every Input with a Label. Inputs stretch to their container.

components.title: Label
components.notes: `htmlFor` · own `onPress` on native

components.title: Checkbox
components.notes: `checked onCheckedChange`
components.caption: On native the Label needs its own onPress to toggle.

components.title: Radio group
components.notes: `RadioGroupItem value id` · a `Label htmlFor` the same id names it

components.title: Switch
components.notes: settings on/off
components.caption: Settings-style on/off. For an action, use Toggle instead.

components.title: Select
components.notes: pass safe-area `insets` to `SelectContent`
components.caption: Pass safe-area insets to SelectContent so the sheet clears the home indicator.

components.title: Filter chip
components.notes: neutral-active chips
components.caption: Selected state is inverted neutral, never the brand colour.

components.title: Segmented control
components.notes: 2–4 options, animated thumb
components.caption: 2–4 mutually exclusive options. For content panes use Tabs.

components.title: Search field
components.notes: Input + search icon + clear

components.title: Quantity stepper
components.notes: `min max step`

components.title: Rating
components.notes: stars · display (half stars, `showValue`, `count`) or input with `onChange` (44pt radio stars)
components.api: <Rating value onChange? showValue? count? size? accessibilityLabel? />
components.caption: Show a score with the number beside it; ask for one after something is done (an order delivered), not in the middle of a task.

components.title: Amount input
components.notes: hero money field · `editable={false}` with keypad
components.api: <AmountInput value onChangeText symbol helper? onMax? onToggleCurrency? error? editable? />
components.caption: Hero numeric entry. Set editable={false} when a NumericKeypad drives it.

components.title: Numeric keypad
components.notes: 3×4 in-app keypad, keys on `bg-muted`
components.caption: Replaces the system keyboard on full-screen amount entry. Long-press ⌫ clears.

components.title: OTP input
components.notes: N-digit code, paste-aware
components.caption: Try 123456. Handles paste and backspace across cells.

components.title: Password input
components.notes: Input + show/hide

components.title: Selectable card
components.notes: card as a radio/checkbox choice
components.api: <SelectableCard title description? icon? detail? selected onPress mode="radio|checkbox" />
components.caption: A whole card as a choice. Selection shows as a ring/check plus a tinted border, not colour alone.

components.title: Slider
components.notes: continuous/stepped · `tone` · `accessibilityLabel` names it
components.api: <Slider value onChange min max step? tone? onChangeComplete? accessibilityLabel />

components.title: Date picker
components.notes: field trigger → Calendar in a Sheet
components.caption: Input-shaped trigger that opens a Calendar in a Sheet.

components.title: Calendar
components.notes: month grid

components.title: Range selector
components.notes: trackless chart range (1D·1W·1M·1Y·ALL), active is a filled disc
components.caption: For the time window over a chart. Use SegmentedControl instead when the options switch content rather than a period.

components.title: Tabs
components.notes: in-page content switching
components.caption: In-page content switching. App-level tabs are the Expo Router tab bar.

components.title: Menubar
components.notes: web/desktop pattern
components.caption: Mostly a web/desktop pattern; prefer a DropdownMenu on phones.

components.title: Tab bar
components.notes: custom bottom tab bar: opaque tints, label, active dot under the label
components.caption: The kit tab bar: opaque tints, label, and an active dot under the label so selection is not colour-only. TabBarItem is exported for custom bars.

components.title: Kit chip
components.notes: scaffolding, not a product component: the way back to the kit from a sample. Not on the Components page; delete it with the kit shell

components.title: Stepper
components.notes: `numbered` / `compact` flow progress

components.title: Section header
components.notes: title + action, outside the card
components.caption: Sits outside the card it introduces.

components.title: Screen header
components.notes: the in-body page title + intro · one per screen, first child of the ScrollView
components.caption: One per screen, as the first child of the ScrollView. Section titles further down the page are SectionHeader, not this.

components.title: Pager dots
components.api: <PagerDots count activeIndex /> — HorizontalPager renders them for you
components.caption: Full-width slides: HorizontalPager with itemWidth = screen width. The dots are bound to the pager; use PagerDots alone only for a custom pager.

components.title: Horizontal pager
components.notes: snap pager + dots
components.caption: Peeking cards: itemWidth smaller than the screen shows the next card. Dots included.

components.title: Text
components.notes: the only Text · the scale is previewed in **Foundations › Typography**, not Components

components.title: Avatar
components.notes: image + fallback initials
components.caption: Default 48px. Image with initials fallback; size with size-8 / size-16; rounded-lg for a square.

components.title: Avatar group
components.notes: overlapping avatars + "+N"

components.title: Badge
components.notes: tag/pill/count · tint with semantic classes
components.caption: Tint with a semantic class (bg-success + text-success-foreground), never a raw colour.

components.title: List row
components.notes: ONE row · the canonical row · `last` on the final row · `select={{mode,selected}}` makes it a radio/checkbox row
components.api: <ListRow leading title subtitle? value? sublabel? trailing? chevron? onPress? last? />
components.caption: The canonical row. Put rows inside a Card with px-4 py-0; mark the last one `last`.

components.title: List group
components.notes: the CONTAINER around rows: owns the title, dividers, footnote and card/plain surface · wraps ListRows and sets `last` for you · `variant` card/plain (plain = settings look)
components.caption: Wraps ListRows and sets `last` on the final one for you. `plain` drops the card for the settings look; pair with ListRow `select` for radio or checkbox rows.

components.title: Icon circle
components.notes: leading icon well, row scale (≤44px) · `shape` circle/square · `tone`
components.caption: Row scale only — 32–64px. `square` is the rounded-square well. At illustration scale (64px and up) use Spot instead.

components.title: Summary card
components.notes: label/value rows, optionally in a Card

components.title: Stat tile
components.notes: KPI tile with delta

components.title: Percent change
components.notes: signed % with trend icon

components.title: Progress ring
components.notes: circular determinate progress

components.title: Timeline
components.notes: vertical status steps joined by a line · each `done` / `current` / `upcoming` with time and note
components.api: <Timeline items={[{ title, time?, description?, state }]} tone? />
components.caption: For what already happened and what comes next (an order, a delivery, an application). A flow the person is filling in uses Stepper.

components.title: Line chart
components.notes: interactive/sparkline · `area` · `onPointerChange`
components.api: <LineChart data variant="interactive|sparkline" height tone area? onPointerChange? />
components.caption: Interactive variant reports the scrubbed point; render your own header from it.

components.title: Bar chart
components.notes: plain Views

components.title: Donut chart
components.notes: ring + legend

components.title: Value header
components.notes: hero figure + caption · `maskable` adds the eye toggle
components.api: <ValueHeader value label? caption? captionTone? maskable? align? />
components.caption: The hero figure at the top of a screen. `maskable` adds the eye toggle for anything someone might not want visible over their shoulder.

components.title: Alert
components.notes: inline, persistent · `variant` default/info/success/warning/destructive · `icon` · `onDismiss`/`action` make it a nudge
components.caption: Inline and persistent, tinted by tone. For transient messages use Toast. `onDismiss` and `action` turn it into a nudge — never dismissible for an error the user must act on.

components.title: Skeleton
components.caption: Match the shape of the content it stands in for.

components.title: Toast
components.notes: transient · `ToastProvider` is in the root layout
components.caption: Transient, bottom-anchored, tap to dismiss. Persistent messages use Alert.

components.title: Spinner
components.notes: themed ActivityIndicator · announced as "Loading"

components.title: Empty state
components.notes: `default` / `compact`

components.title: Success screen
components.notes: the one success template
components.caption: Use for EVERY success state: signup done, booking confirmed, order placed. Optional amount/subtitle when a value matters. Actions go in a StickyBottomBar below it.

components.title: Card
components.notes: never nest cards; titles sit outside · **flat — a shadow means pressable or floating**
components.caption: Never nest cards. Section titles sit outside the card.

components.title: Sticky bottom bar
components.notes: safe-area action bar under a ScrollView (`pb-32`)
components.caption: Render after the ScrollView; give the scroll content pb-32. Children share the width equally.

components.title: Promo card
components.notes: tinted offer/nudge card · circular arrow CTA, dismiss X, generated art · one per screen
components.api: <PromoCard title body? action? onDismiss? tone? seed? icon? />
components.caption: At most one per screen, and dismissible whenever it is promotional rather than required. The art is generated from the seed, so it needs no asset.

components.title: Footnote
components.notes: small print / disclosure, last in the scroll
components.caption: Disclosures at the foot of a screen. Keep it last in the scroll, after the final section.

components.title: Prose
components.notes: long-form text (articles, help, onboarding copy) at the theme's typeset: flow, measure, leading
components.caption: Paragraphs are `Text variant="p"`; the flow is the only spacing between blocks. Text only inside.

components.title: Dialog
components.notes: edits with a form
components.caption: For edits with a form. Confirmations use AlertDialog.

components.title: Alert dialog
components.notes: confirmations

components.title: Popover
components.caption: A small anchored panel for a quick edit or extra detail next to its trigger. For a full form use Dialog; for a list of actions use DropdownMenu.

components.title: Dropdown menu
components.notes: pass `insets`

components.title: Context menu
components.notes: long-press

components.title: Hover card
components.caption: Opens on press on native.

components.title: Sheet
components.notes: bottom sheet shell
components.caption: The base for OptionSheet and ActionSheet. Native mobile pattern; prefer over Dialog for pickers.

components.title: Option sheet
components.notes: pick one of N

components.title: Action sheet
components.notes: list of actions + Cancel

components.title: Icon
components.notes: lucide wrapper
components.caption: Lucide has 1,500+ icons. Colour with a text-* class; never import lucide outside this atom.

components.title: Logo
components.notes: the brand from lib/brand.ts (theme studio › Use theme › Brand assets) · one-colour logos follow the theme · placeholder + name without one
components.caption: Your logo, in the scheme on screen. Without one it's a placeholder square and the name, so screens look right before a brand is applied.

components.title: Image tile
components.notes: rounded image · `seed` draws generated art when there is no `source`
components.caption: Rounded image with a muted placeholder while loading or when there is nothing to show.

components.title: Placeholder
components.notes: deterministic abstract SVG art from a `seed` · the kit ships no raster imagery
components.caption: Stand-in imagery that never 404s. Drawn from theme colours, so it follows light/dark and re-brands with the tokens — use it instead of shipping placeholder files.

components.title: Spot
components.notes: an icon at illustration scale (≥64px) · EmptyState, SuccessScreen and PermissionPrimer all use it
components.caption: The whole illustration vocabulary: an icon at display scale. EmptyState, SuccessScreen and PermissionPrimer all render one. For a row’s leading slot use IconCircle — the boundary is 44px.

components.title: Pricing card
components.notes: one plan · stack 2–3 on a paywall · `highlighted` on one
components.api: <PricingCard name price period? description? features action highlighted? />
components.caption: A paywall stacks two or three plans; highlight the one you recommend, and only one.

components.title: Chat message
components.notes: one turn · user = bubble on the right, assistant = plain text on the left
components.caption: Assistant turns are documents, not bubbles: long answers stay readable. A string child is wrapped in Text for you.

components.title: Chat composer
components.notes: the arrow sends · `busy` turns Send into Stop · `onAttach` turns on attachments (paperclip, chips)
components.api: <ChatComposer onSend={(text, files) => …} busy? onStop? placeholder? onAttach? maxFiles? />
components.caption: Pass `onAttach` only when the assistant can use files; it returns the files to attach (mock ones in a prototype). Files can be reviewed and removed before sending.

components.title: Attachment chip
components.notes: a file in a conversation: icon by type, name, size · `onRemove` while composing
components.caption: ChatComposer shows these itself; use it to show the files in a sent message. Without `onRemove` it is read-only.

components.title: Chat thread list
components.notes: past conversations, grouped by when · `threads activeId onSelect onNew?`
components.caption: A screen of its own on phones, or inside a Sheet. Title threads by their topic, not “New chat”.

components.title: Sources
components.notes: what an answer is based on · numbered chips · `[n]` in text → inline citations · previews in a Sheet
components.api: <CitedText text="… [1]" sources={[{ title, meta?, snippet?, href? }]} /><SourceList sources />
components.caption: Cite whenever the answer uses the person’s data or a document. Stream the answer with stripCitations, then show CitedText and SourceList once it is complete.

components.title: Follow-up suggestions
components.notes: next questions under the latest answer · tapping one sends it
components.caption: Two to four, phrased as the person would ask them, only under the latest answer, and hidden while the assistant is answering.

components.title: Streaming text
components.notes: an answer arriving · all at once under reduced motion · screen readers get it once

components.title: Thinking indicator
components.notes: the model is working · say what it is doing when you can · still dots under reduced motion

components.title: Tool call card
components.notes: an action the assistant took · `status` running/done/error/stopped · details collapsed
components.caption: Name the action in words (“Searched orders”), not the function name. A call the person cancelled is `stopped`, not `error`.

components.title: Approval card
components.notes: consent before consequence · says what changes and whether it can be undone
components.caption: Ask before anything irreversible or costly. The title is the action as a sentence the person can say yes to.

components.title: Camera
components.notes: camera + library · falls back to a seeded `Placeholder`
components.api: <PhotoCapture value? onChange? sources? shape="tile|avatar|wide" label? seed? simulate? />
components.caption: Tap to take or choose a photo. Falls back to generated art wherever there is no camera — the web preview, the simulator, a declined permission — so the screen still reads as filled.

components.title: Code scanner
components.notes: QR/barcode viewfinder · simulated emits a sample payload
components.api: <CodeScanner onScan types? hint? ratio? continuous? simulatedValues? simulate? />
components.caption: QR and barcode viewfinder. Without a camera it shows the same framing overlay plus a button that emits a sample payload, so the flow behind it stays demonstrable.

components.title: Face ID
components.notes: Face ID gate, or the hook for a single action · real only in a dev build
components.api: <BiometricGate title? subtitle? prompt? locked? onUnlock? simulate?>…</BiometricGate> · useBiometricAuth()
components.caption: Hides its children until Face ID succeeds. Use the hook instead when you are confirming a single action. Real only in a dev build — Expo Go and the web simulate it.

components.title: Permission primer
components.notes: shown BEFORE the OS dialog · the skip is not optional
components.caption: Show this before the OS dialog, never instead of it. The skip is not optional: a prototype must never dead-end on a permission the viewer declined.

components.title: Share
components.notes: OS share sheet · copies to the clipboard on web
components.api: const { share } = useShare(); share({ message?, url?, title? })
components.caption: A hook, not a component — the trigger is an ordinary Button. Copies to the clipboard when the OS sheet is unavailable.

components.title: Notifications
components.notes: in-app banner now (`delay: 0`), real OS notification when scheduled
components.api: const { notify } = useNotify(); notify({ title, body?, delay?, icon? })
components.caption: No delay draws the in-app banner, which looks the same everywhere and is what a demo needs. A delay also schedules the real OS notification when it can.
